<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Creature Comforts](/Feats.aspx?ID=5400) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Barbarian" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=18" />
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 56

**Prerequisites**

**Trigger**
You become [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76).

**Requirements**
You’re under a [morph](/Traits.aspx?ID=657) or [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect.

</column>

---

You've found comfort in the forms of other creatures, insulating yourself from feelings of fear. Reduce your frightened condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

requirement: You’re under a  morph  or  polymorph  effect.
